discovery.source_kind: Manufacturer annual report documenting launch month
discovery.result: Xiaomi's 2023 Annual Report says it launched Xiaomi Pad 6S Pro 12.4 in February 2024; the Xiaomi support FAQ separately lists March 25, 2024 as a launch time, so an exact global release date is withheld.

discovery.source_kind: Manufacturer FAQ launch-date statement retained for conflict review
discovery.result: The FAQ's answer says the launch time was 03/25/2024 but does not specify whether that means global or Philippine retail launch. It conflicts with Xiaomi's annual report month and Philippine availability reports dated May 2; no exact local first-sale date is inferred.

discovery.source_kind: Dated Philippine launch availability, launch pricing, configuration, and image candidate
discovery.result: Published 2024-05-02; says the Pad 6S Pro arrives in the Philippines, identifies 8/256 at PHP 33,999 and 12/512 at PHP 39,999, and reports May 3-9 promotional prices of PHP 31,199 and PHP 37,199. Also displays an exact-model product photograph; republication rights were not found.

discovery.source_kind: Independent Philippine launch-price cross-check and promotion conflict evidence
discovery.result: Published 2024-05-02 and reports the same two launch prices/configurations. Its early-bird report gives PHP 31,999/PHP 37,999 through May 4 and an additional PHP 800 discount on May 5, differing from YugaTech's May 3-9 price window; both are retained as reported promotion observations, not reconciled into one offer.

discovery.source_kind: Independent Philippine availability, price, and configuration cross-check
discovery.result: Published 2024-05-02; reports the model officially available in the Philippines and gives both local configurations, launch prices, and early-bird prices.

discovery.source_kind: Current local cash-price and branch-availability observation for 8/256 GB
discovery.result: As observed 2026-11-27, iWarehouse lists Xiaomi Pad 6S Pro Graphite Gray, 8GB/256GB, PHP 22,999 cash, available at one location. The site says stock is informational and not reserved and advises calling first; condition and exact branch stock are not specified.

discovery.source_kind: Current exact-configuration retailer price listing for 12/512 GB
discovery.result: As observed 2026-11-27, the live Xiaomi listing shows the 12GB/512GB Pad 6S Pro at PHP 39,999 and provides an installment purchase route. It does not establish condition or branch-level stock; retained as a dated listed price, not guaranteed availability.
